g.text: Flue area (tinted): at least equal to
Flue pipe connected to the flue,
28 900 mm² is not less than 17 671 mm²: the flue area is at least equal to that of the pipe.
Sentence (1): apart from fireplace chimneys (Article 9.21.2.5.), the flue size itself comes from the appliance
installation standards referenced in Sentences 9.33.5.2.(1) and 9.33.5.3.(1).
